content.content:
The user asks: "Identify the countries in South Asia and the name of the anthems of each of these countries in english text (untranslated)". Need to list South Asian countries and the English titles of their national anthems (as commonly referred to in English). Provide list.

South Asia region typically includes: Afghanistan? Usually South Asia includes Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka. Some definitions include also Iran? but generally SAARC countries: Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka. Also sometimes includes Tibet? Not a country. So answer with those eight.

Provide anthem names: Afghanistan – "Millī Surūd" (National Anthem of Afghanistan) – English title "National Anthem of Afghanistan". Bangladesh – "Amar Shonar Bangla". English translation: "My Golden Bengal". But they ask "in english text (untranslated)" meaning the English title as used. Usually the anthem's official name is in local language, but we can give the English translation? They say "untranslated", meaning the English text of the anthem? Actually "name of the anthems ... in english text (untranslated)". Might mean give the name in English, not translated into another language. So give official English names: e.g., "National Anthem of Afghanistan", "National Anthem of Bangladesh (Amar Shonar Bangla)", but maybe they want the English names of the anthems as used in English, e.g., "National Anthem of India – Jana Gana Mana". So list each country and anthem name.

Provide table.

Will answer directly, no external tool needed.

content:
**South Asian Countries & the English‑language titles of their National Anthems**  

| Country | Anthem (English‑language title) |
|---------|---------------------------------|
| Afghanistan | **“National Anthem of Afghanistan”** (also known by its Pashto title *“Milli Surūd”*) |
| Bangladesh | **“Amar Shonar Bangla”** – English rendering: *“My Golden Bengal”* (officially referred to in English as **“National Anthem of Bangladesh”**) |
| Bhutan | **“National Anthem of Bhutan”** (commonly called *“Druk Tsenden”*) |
| India | **“Jana Gana Mana”** – English rendering: *“Thou Art the Ruler of the Minds of All People”* (officially **“National Anthem of India”**) |
| Maldives | **“National Anthem of the Maldives”** (commonly known by its Dhivehi title *“Qaumiyyaa”*) |
| Nepal | **“National Anthem of Nepal”** (commonly known by its Nepali title *“Sayaun Thunga Phoolka”*) |
| Pakistan | **“National Anthem of Pakistan”** (commonly known by its Urdu title *“Pak Sarzamin”*) |
| Sri Lanka | **“National Anthem of Sri Lanka”** (commonly known by its Sinhalese title *“Sri Lanka Matha”*) |

**Notes**

1. The titles above are the standard English designations used in official documents, diplomatic references, and international listings.  
2. Many of the anthems have native‑language titles (shown in parentheses) that are transliterated; the English titles are the ones most often cited in English‑language sources.  
3. The list follows the conventional definition of South Asia as the eight SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation) member states.
